column1: # The one list of the test areas (spec 171): `tools/check.sh` reads it (check_areas.sh's `areas_load`) and
# `build.zig` embeds it, so `zig build` rebuilds when it changes; `check.sh scope()` counts it shared.
# Tab-separated, one row an area; `#` lines and blank ones are ignored. The columns:
#   step      the `zig build test-STEP` step and `check.sh STEP` verb
#   kind      host: no GPU, no kernels linked (the areas the host tier's steps cover first); gpu: a run takes
#             gpu.lock; whole: gpu, and the binary built with `tier.whole` true for the whole-model tests
#   tier      yes: the step is a tier of its own that also runs the tools' test steps (the host tier)
#   split     yes: `full` splits the step between the two Sparks (`check.sh split`, in this file's order);
#             only the host's subareas, which the host tier's root already holds, may say no
#   seconds   the split's fallback cost of the step where no `*-full-STEP.times` table says otherwise
#             (a row of split=no has `-`)
#   model     `zig/src/models/`, `zig/kernels/` and `zig/tests/fixtures/`'s name the step scopes changed
#             paths to (`check.sh`'s scope), or `-` where the step is no model's
#   root      the step's explicit Zig test root: `zig/STEP_tests.zig` by convention
#   filters   the step's `-Dtest-filter`s when none is asked for, `|`-separated (`-` = every test the
#             binary lists); the whole row's are the full tier's `tier.whole` test names — the list
#             `build.zig` once held as `whole_tests`, now this row alone
#   about     `zig build`'s one line on the step
